_comment: FIXTURES - synthetic evaluation data for A4 narrative faithfulness. Every entity, figure, tender and evidence item below is invented for testing. The narratives labelled unfaithful are deliberately wrong and exist so the self check can be scored on catching them. Nothing here may be published.

cases.narrative:
## Reported

The Revised Estimate for the year is 19,750.00 INR crore, below the Budget Estimate of 21,000.00 INR crore [source:401] [source:402]. Cumulative expenditure to 30 November 2025 stood at 9,100.00 INR crore [source:403]. That is 46.1 percent of the current authority of 19,750.00 INR crore.

## Observable activity

One matching tender was published in the central procurement portal during the year, worth 340.00 INR crore [tender:FX/2025/0011]. A review meeting was reported in October 2025 [evidence:71].

## What is not in the record

The expenditure figure is a cumulative account to 30 November 2025 and central accounts run roughly two months behind, so activity after that date is not reflected. No evidence found in the indexed sources describes how the released funds were applied.
cases.label: faithful

cases.narrative:
## Reported

## Observable activity

No matching tenders were found.

## What is not in the record

No evidence found in the indexed sources for this period.
cases.label: unfaithful

cases.narrative:
## Reported

The allocation was 8,000.00 INR crore [source:511] and releases to 31 December 2025 were 2,600.00 INR crore [source:512], which is 32.5 percent of the allocation.

## Observable activity

No matching tenders were found in the central procurement portal.

## What is not in the record

No evidence found in the indexed sources for this scheme and year.
cases.label: unfaithful
cases.note: The arithmetic is correct. It still fails, because the figure is not in the facts and a reader cannot trace it to a source record. Supplying the share as a derived fact is the fix.
